events.title: Updated character visuals and combat animations
events.summary: We have updated the characters and combat presentation in RuiNsGate Survivors. Player characters and companions now use 3D models, with updated walking and attack animations. Weapon effects and character movements have been adjusted. The camera for mid-boss encounters and the presentation of boss entrances and defeats have been updated. events.title: Major Demo Update: New Zimut Plains, Bravely Burst, and Mastery
events.summary: The RuiNsGate Survivors demo has been updated. The biggest change is a rebuilt first stage, Zimut Plains. Follow its paths or venture off them to find springs and crates, then make your way through the forest-bordered field to the northern gate and its boss. When the enemy crowd closes in, you now have Bravely Burst: a limited-use area attack. The first adventure introduces it, and related quests and refills become available at the guild.
